name: intro-disclosure
blurb: Multi-step feature tour with desktop dialog and mobile drawer views.
description: An IntroDisclosure with configurable steps, media (image/video), actions, and responsive layout; desktop uses Dialog, mobile uses Drawer with swipe.
use_when: Onboarding users with comprehensive feature tours that adapt to their device with step navigation and media.
avoid_when: For simple one-step modals — this is designed for multi-step feature tours with rich media.
a11y: Keyboard navigation (arrow keys); drag/swipe on mobile; focus management; skip option; don't-show-again persisted to localStorage.
